result.title: FocusAnchor: Zero-Shot Metric Depth by Anchoring a Depth Foundation Prior to Focus Cues
result.summary: Existing depth-from-focus methods can struggle with weak focus cues, new cameras, or fewer focal slices. We present FocusAnchor, a recurrent model that uses focus-volume lookups to refine metric depth and repeatedly aligns a relative depth prior from a frozen foundation model to the current depth estimate. The aligned prior guides subsequent refinement in a feedback loop, carrying metric scale recovered from textured regions into regions where focus cues are weak while preserving scene structure. To support transfer across cameras, we synthesize training stacks with randomized camera parameters and focus distances. However, stack synthesis blurs existing image noise differently across slices, creating artificial depth cues even on textureless surfaces. We add independent per-slice noise to suppress these cues. We also introduce variable-stack training to improve robustness with fewer focal slices and support more practical mobile capture. Compared with FOSSA ViT-B, FocusAnchor reduces AbsRel by 36% on NYU Depth V2 and by 9% on DDFF-12 after fine-tuning. In zero-shot evaluation, FocusAnchor and its variable-stack variant, FocusAnchor-flex, achieve the two lowest AbsRel values on all five benchmarks. On ZEDD test, FocusAnchor achieves 9% lower AbsRel than the best competing method, FOSSA ViT-B, while FocusAnchor-flex achieves lower AbsRel with 40% fewer focal slices on ZEDD validation.

AI.brief_summary: FocusAnchor 提出一个循环深度模型，用 focus-volume 查询反复把冻结深度基础模型的相对深度先验对齐到当前估计，形成反馈细化回路，并借助随机相机参数的栈合成、逐切片独立噪声和可变切片数训练提升 zero-shot 跨相机表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「冻结先验—当前估计」的循环对齐回路与可变输入切片数训练，可能为 LVR 中迭代式 latent 状态更新、以及焦点线索薄弱时的视觉证据筛选与先验引导提供方法线索，可供核查状态在迭代中的演化方式。
